title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Sour Lemon Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elf Bar ElfLiq Sour Lemon delivers a bold and tangy citrus flavour, blending zesty lemons with a touch of cooling mint for a refreshingly sharp and vivid vape. The bright, punchy citrus notes create a lively burst of tartness, while a delicate minty freshness softens the profile at the edges, resulting in a perfectly balanced sour-sweet exhale. Blended for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Best suited for low-powered pod kits and starter vape devices, Sour Lemon offers a crisp and invigorating vape with a well-rounded citrus profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Elf Bar ElfLiq brings the most popular Elf Bar disposable flavours into a 10ml e-liquid format, providing a cost-effective and sustainable way to enjoy signature flavours.
